item.title: Trump halts Iran strike, contingent on quick peace deal
item.description: President Trump said Saturday night he would call off a planned attack on Iran, citing progress toward a peace agreement.

item.title: Sen. Moreno says ex-son-in-law Max Miller shouldn't serve in Congress
item.description: Ohio GOP Sen. Bernie Moreno stated that his former son-in-law, Rep. Max Miller, should not hold a congressional seat amid abuse allegations. Miller has denied the claims.
